summary_en: This study tests partial breast irradiation (radiation to part of the breast) in women with early-stage invasive ductal breast cancer who had breast-conserving surgery without sentinel node biopsy or axillary dissection. The radiation is given using 3D, 3D/IMRT or IMRT techniques after breast-conserving surgery, and the dose and number of treatments are not stated. The study measures safety, and patients complete the BCTOS-13 and financial toxicity questionnaires at baseline and at 2 years.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radioterapia parcial de mama (radiación a una parte de la mama) en mujeres con cáncer de mama invasivo de tipo ductal en etapa temprana que se sometieron a cirugía conservadora sin biopsia del ganglio centinela ni disección axilar. La radiación se administra con técnicas 3D, 3D/IMRT o IMRT después de la cirugía conservadora; la dosis y el número de sesiones no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad, y las pacientes completan los cuestionarios BCTOS-13 y de toxicidad financiera al inicio y a los 2 años.
who_for: Women assigned female at birth, age 40 or older
Planned breast-conserving surgery without sentinel node biopsy or axillary lymph node dissection
Invasive ductal carcinoma with pathologic tumor size under 3 cm
No palpable nodes and negative axillary imaging
not_for: History of breast cancer in either breast
Obstacles to informed consent or regular follow-up
